candidates.snippet: 1898: Discovery of Polonium and Radium - Marie and Pierre Curie discovered two new elements, polonium and radium, through their research on radioactivity. 1903: Nobel Prize in Physics - Marie Curie, Pierre Curie, and Henri Becquerel were awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for their joint research on radiation. 1911: Nobel Prize in Chemistry - Marie Curie received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for her discovery of radium and polonium, and her studies of radium. 1914: World War I Service - Marie Curie developed mobile radiography units, known as 'petites Curies,' to provide X-ray services to field hospitals during WWI.
